packageRules.description: loot-rs moves with nvmod (ADR-0015): the Component follower's nvmod bump (scripts/bump-component.sh) moves the components/loot-rs submodule and this Cargo tag to the loot-rs tag nvmod links. A loot-rs release alone would build a second loot-rs beside nvmod's and leave the submodule behind, so the shared preset's first-party Cargo git rule does not apply to it here.
